transforms.code:
"""
	Populate the form’s default-settings dict by:
	  • taking assetName & assetEnabled from the incoming selectedAssetData
	  • overlaying any stored defaults from defaultSettings
	"""
	logger = system.util.getLogger("AssetSettingsTransform")

	# 1) start with the full template of fields
	assetSettings = {
		"stateDetection":    "",
		"microstopDuration": "",
		"modeEntry":         "",
		"defaultRate":       "",
		"stoppedRate":       "",
		"runningDuration":   "",
		"assetName":         "",
		"runningRate":       "",
		"assetEnabled":      False,
		"stoppedDuration":   "",
		"operationOrder":    "",
		"keyCell":           False
	}

	try:
		# 2) ensure we actually got a dict
			# override the two top‐level fields
			if "assetName" in value:
				assetSettings["assetName"] = value["assetName"]
			if "assetEnabled" in value:
				assetSettings["assetEnabled"] = value["assetEnabled"]

			defaults = value.get("defaultSettings")
			for k, v in defaults.iteritems():
				# only apply to keys we know about
				if k in assetSettings:
					assetSettings[k] = v

	except Exception, e:
		# single‐arg .error() to avoid Java Throwable mismatch
		logger.error("Error in AssetSettings transform: %s" % e)

	# 4) hand back the merged settings
	return assetSettings

''' Sends the form data to the assetSettings custom view property where there is a change script that will make the changes in the backend '''
	
	# Gets all the form values
	assetName = self.parent.parent.getChild("NameContainer").getChild("TextField").props.text 
	assetEnabled = self.parent.parent.getChild("DisabledContainer").getChild("Checkbox").props.selected
	modeEntry = self.parent.parent.getChild("ModeEntryContainer").getChild("Dropdown").props.value
	stateDetection = self.parent.parent.getChild("StateDetectionContainer").getChild("Dropdown").props.value
	microstopDuration = self.parent.parent.getChild("MicrostopDurationContainer").getChild("TextField").props.text
	defaultRate = self.parent.parent.getChild("DefaultRateContainer").getChild("TextField").props.text
	runningRate = self.parent.parent.getChild("RunningRateContainer").getChild("TextField").props.text
	runningDuration = self.parent.parent.getChild("RunningDurationContainer").getChild("TextField").props.text
	stoppedRate = self.parent.parent.getChild("StoppedRateContainer").getChild("TextField").props.text
	stoppedDuration = self.parent.parent.getChild("StoppedDurationContainer").getChild("TextField").props.text
	
	# Formats and sends the data to the assetSettings custom view property
	assetSettings = {
		'assetName': assetName,
		'assetEnabled': assetEnabled,
		'modeEntry': modeEntry,
		'stateDetection': stateDetection,
		'microstopDuration': microstopDuration,
		'defaultRate': defaultRate,
		'runningRate': runningRate,
		'runningDuration': runningDuration,
		'stoppedRate': stoppedRate,
		'stoppedDuration': stoppedDuration
	}
	
	self.view.custom.data.assetSettings = assetSettings
